The odd sector may contain genuinely slow modes from base eigenvalues near -1 (exact eigenvalue 9/11 for d=6 bipartite bases), so crude global point-source L2 has a diverging sqrt(n) prefactor at the cutoff front. The localized point-start defect instead has O(log n) L1 Hodge mass and decays as exp(-2t/(2d-1)), making it negligible. This removes the lower-spectral-edge/global-dimension obstruction for this transitive lift.
